# ChargeM3

ChargeM3 is a QR-powered digital menu and ordering platform for restaurants.
Guests scan a QR code at the table to browse the menu, customize and place
orders, and pay securely from their phones — no app installation required.

## Main Services

- QR code digital menus
- Contactless ordering and payment
- Easy menu updates in real time (no app-store resubmits)
- Real-time item availability across locations
- Analytics dashboard with order trends and best-sellers
- Custom branding (colors, fonts, logos)
- Multi-language menus

## Important Pages

- https://chargem3.com/en — product overview, features, pricing, FAQ, demo booking (English)
- https://chargem3.com/bg — same content in Bulgarian

## Summary

ChargeM3 helps restaurants modernize their menu experience, reduce ordering
errors, speed up service, and improve customer experience through QR-based
digital ordering and restaurant management tools.
